beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Coherence Pressure investigates how an elegant explanation can connect observations more strongly than evidence permits.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It begins with a documented conversation where two childhood behaviors became one premature theory.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book examines the steps that made this unification sound intellectually satisfying.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its central distinction is between a coherent representation and a demonstrated common mechanism.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: This proposed explanation remains a hypothesis that existing concepts might already explain.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Readers learn to inspect explanatory bridges while preserving the value of genuine synthesis.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The case begins with two observations about a child's reactions to unwanted experiences.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: One concerns removing an unwanted food from the immediate environment.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The other concerns repeatedly watching a short video despite wanting to stop.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A model connected these observations through an appealing common explanation.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The problem was not that a shared mechanism had been shown impossible.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: It was that the conversation had not established enough evidence to justify that unification.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book examines how individually plausible sentences can support an unwarranted relationship together.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: A descriptive similarity quietly becomes evidence for a shared underlying process.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Terms are compressed, tensions soften, and the unified account starts to feel inevitable.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Correcting the explanation requires separating approach or avoidance from difficulty disengaging.
